# Whisper Dictation

> Free, offline, push-to-talk dictation for macOS with Russian speech recognition.
> Press ⌥Space, speak, press ⌥Space again — the text is inserted into the active app.
> Audio never leaves the Mac; transcription runs locally via whisper.cpp.

## Facts

- Platform: macOS 13 Ventura or later (13, 14 Sonoma, 15 Sequoia, 26+); Apple Silicon only (M1/M2/M3/M4). Intel is not supported.
- Language: Russian by default (`-l ru`); the underlying Whisper model is multilingual,
  but there is no language picker in the UI yet.
- Engine: whisper.cpp 1.9.5, statically linked, model `ggml-large-v3-turbo` (~1.6 GB),
  Metal acceleration. No Python, no cloud, no API keys.
- Cost: free. License: MIT. No account, no telemetry, no analytics.
- Network: only one request — the one-time model download from Hugging Face.
- Privacy: audio goes to a local server on 127.0.0.1 only and is deleted after
  transcription; clipboard content is restored after auto-paste. See PRIVACY.md.
- Signing: ad-hoc, not notarized. First launch requires right-click → Open
  (or System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway). Verify the DMG SHA-256.

## Install

1. Download `WhisperDictation.dmg` from the latest release:
   https://github.com/gimartynov/whisper-dictation/releases/latest/download/WhisperDictation.dmg
2. Open the DMG and drag `WhisperDictation.app` to `/Applications`.
3. First launch: right-click the app → Open → Open.
4. The floating panel appears in the bottom-right corner.
5. Click “Download 1.6 GB” and wait for the model to download and verify.
6. Allow Microphone access.
7. For automatic insertion: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility →
   add `WhisperDictation.app` and enable it, then restart the app.
8. Put the cursor in any text field, press ⌥Space, speak, press ⌥Space again.

## Usage

- ⌥Space — start/stop recording (global hotkey).
- Auto toggle — paste the recognized text into the app that was focused before the panel.
- Copy / Paste / Clear — manual actions in the panel.
- Menu-bar waveform icon — show/hide the panel, About, Quit.
